records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Pioneer Labs!
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Glad to have Pioneer Labs on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Positive, engaged admin: first project reached 7/19, one invite sent, and he replied warmly ([email:9ac50f78]) saying all good, open to a call. But key_milestone still unreached at day 6 with 8 days left, Starter plan, no tickets, and he deferred the call ("at some point"), so momentum is unclear.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield — how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for the quick reply — glad things are going smoothly so far. Happy to take you up on that walkthrough whenever you're ready.

Would a short call this week work? I can walk through how your team is using projects and tasks in Wrenfield and help you get the next piece set up, whatever's most useful. If it's easier, you can also bulk-invite teammates from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and I'm glad to help with that.

Best,
Nadia
